name: Untrusted Project Configuration Admission
mechanism: Prevents repository branches, pull requests and downloaded workspaces from auto-enabling agent configuration, skills, hooks or MCP commands until an immutable diff and authority request are approved.
use_when: Coding agents run against third-party branches or pull requests
Repositories can define agent hooks skills or MCP servers
avoid_when: The workspace is an immutable application-owned release with equivalent admission
Privileged automation cannot disable project-local configuration
failure_modes: A mutable branch changes configuration after approval
Transitive scripts or package hooks remain hidden
Automation loads user-level and project-level settings together
